summary: Iteration 11 tested on PREVIEW (API and UI): the 2 bug fixes from iteration 10, CAG OTP via the BHASHINI relay, scoring model v2 (55/25/20), credits, 3D badges and Title Collection, plus regression. Both bug fixes are VERIFIED. (1) Primary: 0/100 segments done and 0 'Saved' chips after start, after scrolling and after paging Next/Next/Prev. Focusing an editor gives 1/100 plus segment-saved-p13_02. Pro: '0% reviewed', 0/254, and no autosave requests while scrolling 12 screens. Focus gives 1/254 and exactly 1 autosave. (2) The briefing modal is position:fixed, a direct child of body, 1920x1080 at (0,0) with a dimmed backdrop rgba(11,35,66,.6). It auto-opens when hc.briefing.v1 is cleared, and hear-briefing-btn reopens it. OTP request to qa.cr5@cag.gov.in returned 200 {ok:true} (called once). gmail returns 403 email_domain. Scoring v2 verified: Primary with the draft unchanged gives 23.4, which is glossary only (TQ 0, timeliness 0, timelinessGated true). Pro unchanged gives 22.7, also glossary only. Empty Trial gives 0. Reference-quality Trial gives 100 (55/25/20). Partial Trial gives 59.9 (31 + 17.9 + 11.1, one decimal). An improved Primary gives 96 (gain 93%, not gated). measures.model is 2 and the counts.*Marks fields are present. Credits match best x cap / 100 to 1 decimal: 0.8, 7.7, 12.3, 4.8, 5.7, with totals 22.8, 9.8 and 15.5 correct. A lower later attempt did not reduce credits. The score column is double precision. UI checks passed: report card shows the 3 measures with x/55, x/25 and x/20, and 'Needs a 10% quality gain' when gated; the 96px medal has the badge-sweep-once class when a title is won; an old pre-v2 report renders; Training step 2 shows 55/25/20 with the exact descriptions; the Ask Sahayika 'How am I scored?' chip gives the new text; Journey badges have the right data-metal/data-state, and the lock icon appears only on locked badges; Title Collection order is right on desktop and mobile; Hall of Fame shows 4 titles plus Varchaspati (phase2); Leaderboard and Profile show the highest won tier; hover tilt is about 7.2° (max 8°) and 0° with prefers-reduced-motion; rules page and session persistence after reload work. NEW ISSUES: score display rounds decimals; some stale 'five measures' text; stale weights in Sahayika's knowledge.

minor.endpoint: content/sahayika.script.json knowledge.before_game / knowledge.end (used in the LLM prompt by apps/api/src/sahayika/engine.ts:163)
minor.issue: Facts still describe the OLD model: 'five measures ... Proposed weights: translation 30, completion 20, sentence construction 20, glossary 20, time 10', 'time marks taper to 60% at the limit', and the end facts say 'translation out of 10 ... sentence construction out of 10'. Free-text questions that the scripted ask_score intent does not catch can get old weights from the LLM. (My one free-text test was routed to the correct scripted answer.)

Exits with code 1. DATABASE_URL is no longer in /app/backend/.env because it is injected by emergent-env-exec, so the QA helper cannot plant codes. Workaround: /app/backend/tests/iter11_helpers.py reads DATABASE_URL from the running API process env.

Low priority. CAG's own reference text gets a fluency penalty: missing_danda fires on a reference ending in ':', and latin_word fires on 'per cent' carried over from the draft. Even near-reference Hindi in draft rounds tops out below 55 (51/55 with similarity 100%). Consider not penalising grammar codes that also occur in hiReference.

ui_bugs.issue: <CountUp to={r.score} /> has no decimals, so a 23.4 attempt shows '23 / 100' while the chance chip and Sahayika say 23.4. This breaks the one-decimal requirement. Fix: decimals={Number.isInteger(r.score) ? 0 : 1}.
The heading says 'Your five stats' (strings.en.json reportCard.howYouDid) but there are now 3 measures.
Says 'Every translation is evaluated on five essential quality measures.' (strings.onboarding.en.json:57); it should be three.
Each history row shows the round badge in the 'won' state even for failing attempts (Trial 0, Pro 22.7). For consistency it should be locked/greyed when the score is below 33, or neutral.

ui_bugs.component: Report card left panel on a lower re-attempt
ui_bugs.issue: A 23.4 attempt (title already won earlier at 96) still shows the 'TITLE UNLOCKED' panel and '+4.8' credits, which suggests something was earned this attempt. Consider 'Title held' and '+0 (best stands)'. The Sahayika line already says the best stands.

issues: Legacy measures are re-mapped onto the 55/25/20 bars, so the breakdown does not add up to the stored score (39 + 22.7 + 0 = 61.7 vs a stored 49). Acceptable, but consider a 'scored under the earlier model' note.
strings.en.json howToPlay.steps[1].body and howToPlay.points[6] still say 'five measures'. They are not referenced in the web app; remove or update them to avoid confusion.

action_items: Report.tsx:189: show the score with one decimal (CountUp decimals) so 23.4 is not displayed as 23.
Change 'Your five stats' (reportCard.howYouDid) to wording for three measures.
Change the training step 2 sub in strings.onboarding.en.json:57 from 'five essential quality measures' to three.
Update content/sahayika.script.json knowledge facts (before_game weights and time taper, end report-card facts) to model v2: 55/25/20, timeliness linear to 0 at the limit, draft-gain gate.
Fix scripts/emergent/test-otp.sh to read DATABASE_URL from the env when it is not in backend/.env.
Optional: grey the Profile history medals for attempts below 33; on a lower re-attempt, don't show 'TITLE UNLOCKED' or the credits gain.
critical_code_review_comments: Round.tsx:283/286: the onField/onFocus guards work. onField only marks done when the value differs, and onFocus marks done once.
Badge3D: data-testid=medal-<key> repeats on pages with several medals of the same key (journey card plus title collection). Tests must use .first or scope by container.

scoring.ts: the measures.quality share for draft rounds is the gain; similarityPct uses the raw sim while draftSimilarityPct uses the fluency-adjusted quality. The two are not directly comparable (78 vs 76 for an unchanged draft), which can confuse report readers or managers.
Total.tsx uses the looping 'shine' on won medals; only the report card uses the one-time sweep. This is fine if intended.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; 1 HIGH display bug, 2 stale-text bugs)

seed_data_creation: Registered new player qa.cr6@cag.gov.in (QA Cr Six, mobile 9500001106, Bhopal office) and used its chances: Trial 3/3 (0, 100, 59.9), Primary 2/3 (96, 23.4), Pro 1/3 (22.7). qa.cr2@cag.gov.in used 2 Primary chances (23.4, 23.4) and has 1 left. One real OTP email was sent to qa.cr5@cag.gov.in. No data was deleted and no active attempts were left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test-otp.sh is broken (no DATABASE_URL in backend/.env). Use python3 /tmp/plant.py <email> <code> or iter11_helpers.plant(), which read DATABASE_URL from /proc/<api pid>/environ. In the browser tool, use ABSOLUTE URLs for page.request.post (relative ones fail with 'Invalid URL'), and don't use f-strings in screenshot paths because the tool rewrites them. PreRound: wait for the role=button 'Start mission' or 'Resume' before clicking. Submit uses double-press: click the 'Submit Translation' button coordinates twice within 4 s, after which the URL becomes /report/<id>?fx=done (stamp, then scoring interstitial). qa.cr6 has no Trial chances, 1 Primary, 3 Secondary and 2 Pro left. qa.cr2 has 1 Primary and 1 Secondary/Pro left. Use a new qa.cr7+ for further Trial tests. Rerunning test_iter11_scoring_v2.py consumes chances; tests skip when none are left.
rca of the issue: Score shown as an integer: Report.tsx:189 renders <CountUp to={r.score} /> with the default decimals=0 (Juice.tsx CountUp uses v.toFixed(decimals)), so 23.4 renders as '23'. Stale 'five' text: the copy keys reportCard.howYouDid and onboarding training step 2 sub were not updated with the v2 bars.
